# Repository GitHub automation

`.github/` contains repository-owned GitHub Actions and their maintenance notes. Workflow files are operational tooling: they define required validation seams, applicability detection, and evidence collection for the repository and its applications.

The active workflow contract is documented in [`workflows/README.md`](workflows/README.md). Keep workflow changes aligned with the repository's root production rules and the canonical testing/release documentation under [`../doc/`](../doc/).
